releases.notes:
Wayfindr for Minecraft 26.2.

### New

- **Sort your waypoint list.** Order waypoints A to Z, Z to A, or nearest first. Wayfindr remembers your choice.
- **Delete confirmation.** Deleting a waypoint now asks you to click twice, so you won't remove one by accident. Turn it off in Settings.
- **See a waypoint's dimension.** Selecting a waypoint now shows whether it's in the Overworld, the Nether, or the End.
- **A cleaner list.** The `[Personal]` and `[Shared]` tags are hidden by default now. Turn them back on in Settings if you liked them.
- **Sharing controls for server owners.** Turn off waypoint sharing for everyone, or stop specific players from sharing. See the README for setup.

### Changed

- New waypoints from "+ Add Waypoint" get a random color instead of always red, so they're easier to tell apart.

### Fixed

- **Teleporting across dimensions works.** Teleporting to a waypoint in the Nether or the End now takes you to the right place, instead of the same coordinates in the dimension you're already in.
- **Waypoints stay in their own dimension.** A Nether waypoint no longer appears in the Overworld, and the other way around.
- **Shared waypoints don't get lost.** If a server turns down a waypoint you tried to share, it stays as a personal waypoint instead of disappearing.

### Improved

- **Smoother performance.** A much lighter navigation arrow, less network data on servers, and faster saving even with lots of waypoints.

**Requires:** Minecraft 26.2, Java 25, Fabric API, and Fabric Language Kotlin.

releases.notes:
Wayfindr **1.6.2** for **Minecraft 26.2** — bug fixes for the settings screen and waypoint list, following [1.6.1](https://github.com/caleywoods/wayfindr/releases/tag/v1.6.1-mc26.2).

### Fixes
- **Settings now actually save.** On smaller screens / higher GUI scales, the Settings screen's Save and Cancel buttons were positioned off the bottom of the screen and couldn't be clicked, so no configuration change (render distance, placement distance, death waypoints, teleport button) could be persisted. The Settings screen is now laid out responsively with Save/Cancel anchored to the bottom, so they're always reachable. The config file is also now always written in full.

### Changes
- **Deselect a waypoint by clicking it again.** Clicking the currently-selected waypoint in the list now deselects it and returns to the default right-hand panel (Add Waypoint / Settings / Close) — no need to close and reopen the menu to reach Settings.

### Requirements
- **Minecraft 26.2**, **Java 25**
- Fabric Loader 0.19.0+
- Fabric API for 26.2 (`0.155.2+26.2` or newer)
- Fabric Language Kotlin (`1.13.13+kotlin.2.4.10` or newer)

### Install
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.2
2. Drop Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, and `wayfindr-1.6.2-mc26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder
3. Launch with the Fabric profile (Java 25)

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/caleywoods/wayfindr/compare/v1.6.1-mc26.2...v1.6.2-mc26.2

releases.notes:
Wayfindr **1.6.1** for **Minecraft 26.2** — a UI-focused follow-up to [1.6.0](https://github.com/caleywoods/wayfindr/releases/tag/v1.6.0-mc26.2).

### Fixes
- **Waypoint panes stay in sync.** Toggling a waypoint's visibility (Show/Hide) or navigation from the list quick-actions now updates the details pane, and vice-versa — including when stopping navigation. The two views can no longer disagree.
- **Teleport button visible in survival.** It was being drawn underneath the Delete button outside of creative mode, so it looked missing. The Teleport button now shows whenever it's enabled in config; the server enforces `/tp` permission at execution time (operators, or singleplayer with cheats).

### Changes
- **Responsive Waypoint Manager layout.** The whole manager now sizes itself from the current window/GUI scale instead of fixed pixel offsets, so buttons pack sensibly and stop clipping off the bottom on smaller screens — tighter on small resolutions, roomier on large ones.

### Requirements
- **Minecraft 26.2**, **Java 25**
- Fabric Loader 0.19.0+
- Fabric API for 26.2 (`0.155.2+26.2` or newer)
- Fabric Language Kotlin (`1.13.13+kotlin.2.4.10` or newer)

### Install
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.2
2. Drop Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, and `wayfindr-1.6.1-mc26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder
3. Launch with the Fabric profile (Java 25)

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/caleywoods/wayfindr/compare/v1.6.0-mc26.2...v1.6.1-mc26.2

releases.notes:
Wayfindr **1.6.0** for **Minecraft 26.2** — bug fixes and UI polish on top of the [1.5.0 port](https://github.com/caleywoods/wayfindr/releases/tag/v1.5.0-mc26.2).

### Fixes
- **Un-sharing a waypoint no longer deletes it.** Making a previously shared waypoint personal again could wipe it from both your local `waypoints.json` and the server. The server's delete broadcast was echoing back and removing the freshly-converted personal copy. Personal waypoints now ignore server delete broadcasts, and the shared/personal toggle is persisted to disk.
- **Teleport button now works for the right players.** It was gated on creative mode, but `/tp` needs operator permission — so creative non-ops saw a dead button while survival ops saw none. It's now gated on permission level 2 (operators, plus singleplayer with cheats) and can be turned off in the config screen.

### Changes
- **Removed emoji/icons from the UI.** Icons in the waypoint manager could be broken by resource packs. They're replaced with plain ASCII labels (`[Shared]` / `[Personal]`, `1` / `0` for visibility, `>` / `*` for navigation) that render consistently regardless of the active resource pack.

### Requirements
- **Minecraft 26.2**, **Java 25**
- Fabric Loader 0.19.0+
- Fabric API for 26.2 (`0.155.2+26.2` or newer)
- Fabric Language Kotlin (`1.13.13+kotlin.2.4.10` or newer)

### Install
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.2
2. Drop Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, and `wayfindr-1.6.0-mc26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder
3. Launch with the Fabric profile (Java 25)

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/caleywoods/wayfindr/compare/v1.5.0-mc26.2...v1.6.0-mc26.2

releases.notes:
First release of Wayfindr for **Minecraft 26.2**.

This is a port of the mod to the 26.x toolchain (deobfuscated jars, Java 25, the reworked rendering/GUI/input stacks). See [docs/MIGRATION-26.2.md](https://github.com/caleywoods/wayfindr/blob/mc26.2/docs/MIGRATION-26.2.md) for the technical writeup.

### Requirements
- **Minecraft 26.2**
- **Java 25**
- Fabric Loader 0.19.0+
- Fabric API for 26.2 (`0.155.2+26.2` or newer)
- Fabric Language Kotlin (`1.13.13+kotlin.2.4.10` or newer)

### Install
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.2
2. Drop Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, and `wayfindr-1.5.0-mc26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder
3. Launch with the Fabric profile (Java 25)

### Notes
- Waypoint beams, in-world name labels (projected to the HUD), navigation arrow, the waypoint manager GUI, commands, and per-world persistence are all working on 26.2.
- The 1.21.4 / 1.21.5 builds remain on the `main` line; 26.2 lives on the `mc26.2` branch because the toolchains are incompatible.
